description: 每扇门都需要返回地址，必须保留无法确认的路径而非猜测。
descriptionEn: Every portal needs a return address. Mark uncertain routes instead of guessing.

title: 记忆展览
description: 十二位伙伴的讲述都应保留原意，短片不得用一个声音替代所有人。
descriptionEn: Preserve twelve distinct accounts. Do not replace everyone with one voice.

title: 开放手册
description: 让第一次接触工作室的人也能重现实验，标出失败条件。
descriptionEn: Let a newcomer reproduce the experiment, including its failure conditions.
